question: In which two states is the Agasthyamala Biosphere Reserve located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala and Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Agasthyamala Biosphere Reserve is located in the southern part of India, spanning two states: Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is part of the Western Ghats, a mountain range known for its biodiversity and unique ecosystems.
 
• Agasthyamala is named after the sage Agastya, who is considered one of the seven rishis (Saptarishi) in Hindu mythology.
 
• The biosphere reserve is home to various endemic species of flora and fauna, including several rare and endangered species.
 
• It was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016 due to its rich biodiversity and ecological significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Ghats**

 
 
• The Western Ghats are a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of India, known for its high level of biodiversity and endemism.
 
• The range is recognized as one of the world's eight "hottest hotspots" of biological diversity.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India**
 
 
• India is home to several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, including natural, cultural, and mixed sites.
 
• Examples include the Taj Mahal, Kaziranga National Park, and the Sundarbans National Park.
 
 
 
• **Biosphere Reserves in India**
 
 
• India has a total of 18 biosphere reserves, which are areas of terrestrial and coastal ecosystems promoting the conservation of biodiversity.
 
• Some well-known biosphere reserves include the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, Nanda Devi, and Sundarbans.
